import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
import os

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/en_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/en_test_2.csv")

print(f"Training samples: {len(train)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test)}")

# Create validation split by sentence_id to prevent leakage
train_unique_sentences = train["sentence_id"].unique()
print(f"Unique sentences in training: {len(train_unique_sentences)}")

# Split sentences: 80% train, 20% validation (by sentence, not row)
n_sentences = len(train_unique_sentences)
split_idx = int(n_sentences * 0.8)
train_sentences = train_unique_sentences[:split_idx]
val_sentences = train_unique_sentences[split_idx:]

# Split training data
train_df = train[train["sentence_id"].isin(train_sentences)]
val_df = train[train["sentence_id"].isin(val_sentences)]

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(val_df)}")

# Identify unchanged tokens (only on training data)
unchanged_pairs = set()
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    if row["before"] == row["after"]:
        unchanged_pairs.add(row["before"])

print(f"Unchanged tokens found: {len(unchanged_pairs)}")

# Build class-specific mapping: (before, class) -> most common after
before_class_to_after = defaultdict(list)
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    key = (row["before"], row["class"])
    before_class_to_after[key].append(row["after"])

# Create lookup dictionary with most common prediction for each (before, class) pair
class_conditioned = {}
for key, after_list in before_class_to_after.items():
    after_counts = Counter(after_list)
    class_conditioned[key] = after_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

print(f"Unique (before, class) combinations in training: {len(before_class_to_after)}")

# Build position-conditioned mapping: (before, token_id % 50) -> most common after
pos_mod = 50
min_count = 5
before_pos_to_after = defaultdict(list)
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    pos_bucket = row["token_id"] % pos_mod
    key = (row["before"], pos_bucket)
    before_pos_to_after[key].append(row["after"])

# Create position-conditioned lookup with minimum count threshold
position_conditioned = {}
for key, after_list in before_pos_to_after.items():
    if len(after_list) >= min_count:
        after_counts = Counter(after_list)
        position_conditioned[key] = after_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

print(
    f"Unique position-conditioned buckets (count >= {min_count}): {len(position_conditioned)}"
)

# Also build general mapping for tokens without class or position info (for test fallback)
simple_before_to_after = defaultdict(list)
for _, row in train_df.iterrows():
    simple_before_to_after[row["before"]].append(row["after"])

simple_most_common = {}
for before_val, after_list in simple_before_to_after.items():
    after_counts = Counter(after_list)
    simple_most_common[before_val] = after_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]

print(f"Unique 'before' tokens in training: {len(simple_before_to_after)}")

# Evaluate on validation set
print("\nEvaluating on validation set...")
val_preds = []
val_correct = 0
val_total = 0

for _, row in val_df.iterrows():
    val_total += 1
    # For unchanged tokens, predict unchanged
    if row["before"] in unchanged_pairs or row["before"] == row["after"]:
        pred = row["before"]
    else:
        # Try class-conditioned mapping first
        key = (row["before"], row["class"])
        if key in class_conditioned:
            pred = class_conditioned[key]
        else:
            # Fall back to position-conditioned mapping
            pos_bucket = row["token_id"] % pos_mod
            pos_key = (row["before"], pos_bucket)
            if pos_key in position_conditioned:
                pred = position_conditioned[pos_key]
            else:
                # Final fallback to simple most common
                pred = simple_most_common.get(row["before"], row["before"])

    val_preds.append(pred)
    if pred == row["after"]:
        val_correct += 1

val_accuracy = val_correct / val_total if val_total > 0 else 0
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")
print(f"Validation Samples: {val_total}")
print(f"Correct Predictions: {val_correct}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_preds = []

for _, row in test.iterrows():
    # For unchanged tokens, predict unchanged (test doesn't have 'after' column)
    if row["before"] in unchanged_pairs:
        pred = row["before"]
    else:
        # Fallback hierarchy for test (no class column available)
        # Try position-conditioned mapping first
        pos_bucket = row["token_id"] % pos_mod
        pos_key = (row["before"], pos_bucket)
        if pos_key in position_conditioned:
            pred = position_conditioned[pos_key]
        else:
            # Final fallback to simple most common
            pred = simple_most_common.get(row["before"], row["before"])
    test_preds.append(pred)

print(f"\nGenerated {len(test_preds)} test predictions")

# Create submission DataFrame with correct format
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test["sentence_id"].astype(str) + "_" + test["token_id"].astype(str),
        "after": test_preds,
    }
)

print(f"\nSubmission shape: {submission.shape}")
print(f"Submission ID column preview: {submission['id'].head().tolist()}")
print(f"Submission after column preview: {submission['after'].head().tolist()}")

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission size: {len(submission)} rows")
print(f"Validation Accuracy (held-out): {val_accuracy:.6f}")
